opportunities.title: Medleys Profesionales para Grupo en Vivo
opportunities.description: TÍTULO Productor/a musical: 4 medleys con pistas de práctica para grupo en vivo PRESUPUESTO 55 USD, precio cerrado por los 4 medleys completos. DESCRIPCIÓN Necesito a alguien con experiencia en medleys y mashups para crear 4 temas continuos a partir de canciones populares. Están pensados para que los toque un grupo musical sobre un escenario. Te envío las canciones originales y las instrucciones de cada medley; tú los montas, los enlazas y los dejas listos para usar. LOS 4 MEDLEYS • Medley A: 6 canciones de rock en español. • Medley B: 3 canciones de hard rock clásico. • Medley C: 6 canciones de música electrónica y de pista de baile. • Medley D: 4 canciones de pop español de los 80, de unos 7 minutos en total. Total: 19 canciones. TU TRABAJO 1. Estudiar el tempo, la tonalidad y la estructura de cada canción. 2. Editar y encadenar las canciones en el orden que te indique, con los recortes, repeticiones, entradas y cierres necesarios. 3. Crear pasos suaves de una canción a la siguiente, adaptando velocidad y tonalidad si hace falta. 4. Completar con instrumentos virtuales (MIDI) las secciones que lo requieran, para que el resultado suene lleno y encaje con los músicos. 5. En uno de los medleys, construir un cierre con mucha energía, tomando como modelo una grabación en vivo que te enviaré. LO QUE ENTREGAS (de cada medley) • Archivo final en WAV estéreo de 24 bits. • Versión de práctica con metrónomo (click) y pista de referencia. • Pistas por instrumento (stems), siempre que el audio original lo permita. • El archivo de sesión de tu programa, para poder modificar cosas después. • Hasta 3 rondas de cambios. Te los mandaré todos juntos en un único mensaje. PROGRAMAS Un DAW profesional (Ableton Live, Logic Pro, Cubase, Reaper, Pro Tools o similar), herramientas de calidad para cambiar velocidad y tonalidad (Melodyne, Elastique, Pitch 'n Time o parecidas) y bibliotecas de instrumentos virtuales con licencia propia. PERFIL QUE BUSCO • Portafolio con medleys, mashups o montajes para actuaciones. • Buen oído, sentido del ritmo y criterio para encadenar canciones. • Discreción total: no puedes compartir, publicar ni reutilizar nada del material que te envíe, y debes eliminarlo al terminar. • Respuestas rápidas y claras. PLAZO Y PAGO Primera entrega en 5 días como máximo desde la adjudicación. Dime en tu oferta el plazo que puedes cumplir. El pago se hace por hitos, a través de la plataforma. CÓMO OFERTAR En tu propuesta incluye tu plazo y un ejemplo de un trabajo parecido. Sin ejemplo, no se tendrá en cuenta la oferta.

¡Hola EMPRESA SOCIAL DEL ESTADO SAN SEBASTIAN DE LA PLATA (La Plata)! 👋 Revisé la solicitud exacta de **"🏛️ [Circular 188-2026] EMPRESA SOCIAL DEL ESTADO SAN SEBASTIAN DE LA PLATA (La Plata) — PRESTACION DE SERVICIOS"** y cumplo con los requisitos para iniciar de inmediato.

📲 Contacto directo en San Agustín, Huila (Colombia): **+57 322 273 9034**.

opportunities.title: Migrate Mobile WhatsApp to Business
opportunities.description: I need a smooth hand-over of my current mobile number from regular WhatsApp to WhatsApp Business. The number is active on the standard app right now, so before we upgrade I want to create a secure backup of only the chats I mark as important—no blanket export of everything. Once those key conversations are saved, guide me through (or handle, if possible via remote session) the actual migration so the same phone number activates inside WhatsApp Business with a proper business profile. I’m not looking to set up catalogs or automated replies today; the goal is simply to preserve chosen chats, move the number, and confirm contacts appear intact in the new app. If you’ve already helped others with Google Drive/​iCloud chat backups and number transfers to WhatsApp Business, that’s exactly the experience I’m after.

opportunities.title: Student Hostel Layout Design
opportunities.description: I’m converting a small site into a student hostel that will house up to 30 residents, and I need a smart, space-efficient layout plan. The non-negotiable element is that every bedroom must have its own separate bathroom—no communal washrooms. Around those private rooms I’d like the usual student necessities: a quiet study area, a relaxed common lounge, and a combined kitchen-dining space (with laundry facilities worked in if the footprint allows). I’m open to creative solutions such as mezzanines, multifunctional furniture, or flexible partitions, as long as privacy, fire-safety, and accessibility standards are met. Deliverables • Scaled floor plan (PDF + editable DWG/Revit/SketchUp file) showing room dimensions, furniture placement, and plumbing cores • At least one 3D visual or schematic to help me present the concept to investors • A concise design rationale covering circulation, daylight, ventilation, and compliance with local student-housing codes (I’ll supply the regulations once we start) Acceptance criteria • Capacity capped at 30 students, with no dorm larger than four beds • En-suite bathroom for every room • All egress, fire, and accessibility requirements satisfied I can provide site measurements, zoning details, and photos right away. The ideal turnaround is within two weeks, but let me know if you need more time so we can set milestones that work for both of us.

opportunities.title: Apple of Fortune Dashboard
opportunities.description: I run sessions of the “Apple of Fortune” game on 1xBet and need a lightweight script that lets me feed in each new outcome—either by typing the result or pasting data pulled from a quick screenshot—and immediately displays a clean, chronological history of recent results on screen. Key points I need covered: • Input flexibility: I will either enter the symbols/colours manually or copy them from a screenshot; whichever is faster in the moment. • Simple, clear interface: as soon as I add a new entry it should appear at the top of the list, pushing older results down so I can glance at the latest streak. • No betting automation, no fancy analytics—just the rolling history so I can track patterns myself. The script can be web-based (HTML/CSS/JavaScript) or a small desktop tool—whichever you are most comfortable delivering quickly. All I need back is the functioning code with a short read-me explaining how to add results and reset the log.

opportunities.title: Plataforma Repuestos y Talleres Chile
opportunities.description: Quiero desarrollar una plataforma web que conecte casas de repuestos automotrices con talleres mecánicos en Chile. El objetivo es que los talleres puedan buscar repuestos, comparar ofertas de distintas casas de repuestos y solicitar pedidos sin tener que desplazarse físicamente. La plataforma debe funcionar desde computadores y teléfonos celulares Integración automática con los inventarios de las tiendas. Búsqueda avanzada por VIN. Catálogo completo de compatibilidad de vehículos. Integración con Uber, Rappi u otros servicios de reparto. Pagos en línea. Geolocalización Es importante que: - La plataforma sea adaptable a celulares y computadores. - La base de datos esté bien organizada. - Los datos puedan exportarse. - El proyecto quede dentro de una cuenta de Bubble controlada por el propietario del negocio. - El propietario tenga acceso de administrador. - El desarrollo quede documentado para que otro programador pueda continuarlo. - Se utilicen herramientas y plugins cuyo costo recurrente esté claramente informado.

opportunities.title: Build AI Sales Call Automation Platform
opportunities.description: We want to build and own a service that calls our Sales team as soon as a vehicle enquiry comes in, connects an agent to the customer and shows managers which leads were missed, which need a callback and how well the team handled each call. How the system should work 1. When an Auto Trader enquiry comes in, our existing Leads feed continues as normal. The new service receives a copy by email or approved API, reads the customer’s phone number, vehicle and enquiry. 2. The service calls our direct number, which rings the Sales hunt group. When someone answers, they hear a short summary of the enquiry and press 1 to accept. Only then does the service dial the customer and connect both calls. 3. The system records what happened. We need to distinguish no agent accepted, customer didn’t answer, voicemail reached with no message left, voicemail left, customer reached and call failed. Where the evidence is unclear, flag the outcome for review. 4. Leads needing follow-up go into a live queue with an owner and a due time. The system should respect opening hours. AI call scoring and coaching We want the system to transcribe calls and score them against criteria we can edit ourselves. The AI should listen for whether the agent answered the enquiry, asked relevant questions, offered a specific appointment where appropriate, handled objections and agreed a clear next step. Each score should include a short quote, a recording timestamp and a practical coaching point. Managers should be able to correct scores and outcomes. We’ll supply reviewed calls to calibrate the scorecard before the pilot. Dashboard and automated emails - Live callback queue showing missed drips, customer voicemails, overdue callbacks and who owns each lead. - Daily management email with separate sections for drips nobody accepted and calls that went to customer voicemail. Show whether a message was left, what action has been taken and what still needs doing. - Weekly coaching email showing response times, calls accepted, customers reached, appointments booked and coaching points by agent. - Performance dashboard with filters by date, lead source and agent. It should be possible to open a report row and see the enquiry, call history, recording, transcript and outcome where available. Who we’re looking for A senior developer who has personally built a live programmable voice system, another voice API or SIP. You should have experience connecting two calls, collecting keypad input, handling caller ID and call-status events, and working with recordings and an existing phone system. We also need experience with backend APIs, email intake, scheduled reporting and AI transcription or scoring. How we’ll start Please quote separately for a paid proof of concept using sample enquiries and test numbers. The first milestone must show that the system can ring our hunt group, read the enquiry, accept a keypad response, connect the customer, display the agreed caller ID and capture the full recording. We also want to establish how the answering agent can be identified reliably. Please include an example of a live voice system you personally built, your proposed approach, how you’d distinguish voicemail reached from voicemail left, and your estimated cost and timeline for the remaining build. Include expected monthly running costs and the assumptions behind them. The source code, hosting and service accounts must be under my control. Handover should include setup documentation, access controls and configurable recording retention.

opportunities.title: YouTube Editing & Social Auto-Posting
opportunities.description: I create “automation-style” content and need someone who can take my raw footage and turn it into polished YouTube videos, then push those videos (and their short-form cut-downs) out to my other channels without any extra clicks on my side. Here’s the flow I’m after 1. You receive the raw talking-head clips, screen recordings and voice-over. 2. You edit a full-length YouTube video that matches the fast-paced, faceless-automation niche—clean jump cuts, on-screen captions, stock b-roll, royalty-free music and sound effects. 3. You extract one or two vertical shorts from the same footage, optimised for YouTube Shorts. 4. When I approve the edits, your automation publishes the long video to YouTube and schedules the shorts across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube Shorts with the titles, descriptions and hashtags I supply. Use whatever stack you prefer—Zapier, Make (Integromat), Buffer, native APIs, or a custom script—as long as the end result is a single workflow that keeps my content calendar moving without manual uploads. Deliverables • 1 fully edited YouTube video (1080p or 4K, .mp4) • 2 vertical shorts (9:16, ≤60 s) • A working automation workflow file, scenario link, or script with basic documentation so I can update credentials and tweak posting times later. The project is done when all four platforms—Instagram & Facebook, TikTok & YouTube—are receiving scheduled posts automatically and the videos match the visual style we agree on during the first draft.

opportunities.title: YouTube Documentary Style Video Editor
opportunities.description: Every month I publish a new true-crime mystery on my YouTube channel and want each episode cut into a punchy, attention-grabbing mini-documentary. The tone must stay fast-paced with frequent use of archival photos, courtroom footage, newspaper clippings, lower-third text, and subtle motion graphics that push the story forward without overwhelming the narration. You will edit the raw narration track and layer it with suspenseful yet non-intrusive background music, atmospheric sound effects, and quick transitions that keep viewers glued from hook to ending. Expect to source or create royalty-free b-roll when my material runs thin and colour-grade everything so the final piece feels cohesive and cinematic. Deliverables • 10–15 min finished 1080p (or higher) video ready for upload • Separate .srt captions file for accessibility • Editable project file (Premiere Pro, After Effect, Blender) with organised bins and media links Acceptance Criteria • Pacing never lets more than five seconds pass without a visual change • On-screen text aligns perfectly with key narrative beats • Music levels side-chained so the voice-over remains crystal clear • All third-party footage, images, and fonts are royalty-free or licensed for YouTube monetisation If true-crime storytelling is your passion and you thrive on quick cuts, dramatic reveals, and meticulous sound design, this project should feel like second nature. I look forward to reviewing a short show-reel or sample edit that proves you can bring dark mysteries to life with cinematic flair.

opportunities.title: Pune 2BHK Luxury 3D Interior
opportunities.description: I’m ready to transform my 2-bedroom flat in Pune into a truly premium space and I need full-scope 3D design support to make it happen. The brief covers every corner of the apartment—living room, both bedrooms, kitchen, utility, bathrooms and circulation areas—so you’ll build a complete model rather than focusing on isolated rooms. The look I’m after is luxury and premium: rich finishes, thoughtful lighting layers, statement pieces and a seamless flow from one space to the next. Alongside the visual elegance, smart storage is critical. Please weave generous yet unobtrusive storage into the kitchen and utility zone, both bedrooms (wardrobes, under-bed, lofts) as well as the living room and entrance area so the home stays clutter-free. What I expect from you • Two or more distinct concept options, each shown in a fully navigable 3D layout so I can compare styles before locking the final direction. • High-resolution renders for key viewpoints plus a walk-through animation or interactive model link. • Annotated layout drawings with furniture placement, custom carpentry dimensions and electrical / lighting points that align with the chosen concept. • A finishes board specifying materials, colours, loose furniture references and lighting fixtures available in Pune or via reliable online suppliers. Technical comfort with SketchUp, 3ds Max + V-Ray, AutoCAD (or similar) will help streamline revisions because I plan to review the source files with my contractor. Acceptance criteria 1. Both concept packages delivered within the first milestone. 2. Final approved layout, photorealistic renders and working drawings delivered in the second milestone. 3. Storage volumes and dimensions match the agreed brief and are practically buildable by local carpenters. If this sounds like the right fit, let’s discuss timelines and any questions you may have about the space.

opportunities.title: Animated Science Intro Video
opportunities.description: I'm looking for a short YouTube video to introduce my personal website and scientific work. The target audience is the general public, so the content needs to be accessible and engaging. My website has 3D animations written in Javascript included with the discussions, with the animations having controls to play / pause and step through aspects of the animation content. The website discussions are on www.thesimpleuniverse.com The format would perhaps be a talk over of the written discussions on the website, while visually walking through the website, and the existing animations used to help explain the discussions. The video should use animated illustrations to simplify complex concepts and make the science easy to understand. Ideally, the freelancer should have experience in: - Creating engaging animated videos - Simplifying complex scientific content for a general audience - Video production and editing skills Please provide a portfolio showcasing similar work.

opportunities.title: E-commerce Chat Response Specialist
opportunities.description: Project title Virtual Assistant for a UK Online Furniture and Flooring Store: Customer Chat, Orders and Deliveries Description About us Aurino & Co is a UK online store (aurino.co.uk) selling furniture, flooring, wall panels, rugs and home décor. We're a small business. I'm looking for a reliable virtual assistant to take over the day-to-day customer service and order handling, so I can focus on growing the business. This is a long-term role for the right person. What you'll do 1. Customer chats and messages Reply to website chat conversations that our system hands over to a person. You'll do this from our internal dashboard. Spot customers who are close to buying, for example people asking about stock, sizes, colours, delivery dates or prices. Help them decide with clear answers, the right product links and a follow-up. Contact customers by email, phone or WhatsApp about their orders and questions. 2. Supplier orders When a customer orders, place the order with the right supplier. Chase order confirmations, stock levels and dispatch dates. When the supplier's invoice arrives, pass it to me. I pay all invoices, so you won't handle any payments. 3. Deliveries Upload orders to our delivery partners' platforms. Track every order until it reaches the customer, and keep the tracking on each order up to date. Handle delays, failed deliveries and damage reports. Keep the customer informed and sort out the problem with the supplier or courier. 4. Reviews After delivery, check in with customers and ask happy ones for a review. Tell me about any unhappy customer straight away, before it turns into a bad review. Who we're looking for Excellent written English. Our customers are UK homeowners, so your tone should be friendly, clear and professional. Experience in ecommerce customer service, order processing or virtual assistant work. Very organised. Every order should be tracked from start to finish, with nothing missed. Confident with sales: you can tell when someone is ready to buy and help them without being pushy. Quick replies to chats during working hours. Your own computer and a reliable internet connection. Willing to sign a confidentiality agreement, because you'll see customer names, addresses and order details. Hours and pay hours per week to start, 3 days, 10am - 1pm UK time. Paid hourly. More hours are available as the business grows. Start date: asap. How to apply Start your bid with the word "Delivered" so I know you've read this post. Then tell me: Your experience with ecommerce customer service and order handling. The hours you can work, in UK time. How you would reply to this customer chat: "Hi, is the grey corner sofa in stock, and could I get it before the end of the year?" Bids that don't answer these three points won't be considered.

opportunities.title: Βελτίωση εικόνων σε WordPress Elementor -- 2
opportunities.description: Σχετικά με το project Έχω την Boothflix (boothflix.gr), επιχείρηση ενοικίασης photobooth για γάμους, βαπτίσεις και εταιρικές εκδηλώσεις. Το site είναι φτιαγμένο σε WordPress/Elementor. Ψάχνω έμπειρο freelancer για να ανανεώσει την αρχική σελίδα, να προσθέσει νέες σελίδες και να στήσει τη συμμόρφωση με GDPR, το SEO και τις μετρήσεις. Θα δώσω σχέδιο (mockup), όλα τα κείμενα και δικές μου φωτογραφίες. Εργασίες 1. Αρχική σελίδα (νέα δομή) • Το hero με το βίντεο στο φόντο μένει όπως είναι, με μικρές διορθώσεις. • Ενότητα εκδηλώσεων (Γάμος, Βάπτιση, Εταιρικά) σε μικρότερα πλαίσια με δικές μου φωτογραφίες. • 6 κάρτες υπηρεσιών (Mirror, Retro, 360°, Video Wish Phone, Wish Phone, Wish Booth). • Πλέγμα φωτογραφιών από το Instagram, κριτικές πελατών, συχνές ερωτήσεις. 2. Νέες σελίδες • Μία σελίδα για κάθε υπηρεσία (6), με φωτογραφία, περιγραφή και «Τι περιλαμβάνει». • Σελίδες για Γάμο, Βάπτιση, Εταιρικές εκδηλώσεις, Photobooth Αθήνα και Συχνές ερωτήσεις. 3. Κουμπί «Πάρε προσφορά» • Κυκλικό κουμπί σταθερό κάτω δεξιά σε όλες τις σελίδες, που ανοίγει φόρμα επικοινωνίας σε popup. Τα μηνύματα έρχονται στο email μου. • Κουμπιά Κλήσης και WhatsApp. 4. Διορθώσεις στο υπάρχον site • Να φύγουν οι τόνοι από τα κεφαλαία. • Αντικατάσταση των stock φωτογραφιών με δικές μου, ενιαίες γραμματοσειρές, διόρθωση μενού και footer, μικρές οπτικές διορθώσεις. 5. GDPR • Cookie banner με ισότιμα κουμπιά «Αποδοχή / Απόρριψη», σύμφωνα με τις οδηγίες της Αρχής Προστασίας Δεδομένων (ΑΠΔΠΧ), με Google Consent Mode v2. Τα εργαλεία της Google να φορτώνουν μόνο μετά τη συγκατάθεση. • Σελίδα Πολιτικής απορρήτου & cookies και σύντομο σημείωμα κάτω από τη φόρμα. 6. SEO και μετρήσεις • SEO τίτλοι και meta descriptions, sitemap, Google Search Console, συμπίεση εικόνων, 301 redirects για όσα URLs αλλάζουν. Απαιτήσεις • Αποδεδειγμένη εμπειρία σε WordPress και Elementor (με παραδείγματα από sites που είναι online). • Εμπειρία με plugins συγκατάθεσης cookies (π.χ. Complianz, CookieYes) και Google Consent Mode v2. • Βασικές γνώσεις SEO. • Το site να δείχνει τέλεια στο κινητό (mobile-first). Παραδοτέα • Όλες οι αλλαγές ανεβασμένες στο site και ελεγμένες σε κινητό και υπολογιστή. • Backup του site πριν και μετά τις αλλαγές. • Λίστα με τα redirects που έγιναν. • Σύντομες οδηγίες για να μπορώ να αλλάζω μόνος μου φωτογραφίες και κείμενα.

Το site είναι φτιαγμένο σε WordPress/Elementor. Ψάχνω έμπειρο freelancer για να ανανεώσει την αρχική σελίδα, να προσθέσει νέες σελίδες και να στήσει τη συμμόρφωση με GDPR, το SEO και τις μετρήσεις. Θα δώσω σχέδιο (mockup), όλα τα κείμενα και δικές μου φωτογραφίες. Εργασίες 1. Αρχική σελίδα (νέα δομή) • Το hero με το βίντεο στο φόντο μένει όπως είναι, με μικρές διορθώσεις. • Ενότητα εκδηλώσεων (Γάμος, Βάπτιση, Εταιρικά) σε μικρότερα πλαίσια με δικές μου φωτογραφίες. • 6 κάρτες υπηρεσιών (Mirror, Retro, 360°, Video Wish Phone, Wish Phone, Wish Booth). • Πλέγμα φωτογραφιών από το Instagram, κριτικές πελατών, συχνές ερωτήσεις. 2. Νέες σελίδες • Μία σελίδα για κάθε υπηρεσία (6), με φωτογραφία, περιγραφή και «Τι περιλαμβάνει». • Σελίδες για Γάμο, Βάπτιση, Εταιρικές εκδηλώσεις, Photobooth Αθήνα και Συχνές ερωτήσεις. 3. Κουμπί «Πάρε προσφορά» • Κυκλικό κουμπί σταθερό κάτω δεξιά σε όλες τις σελίδες, που ανοίγει φόρμα επικοινωνίας σε popup. Τα μηνύματα έρχονται στο email μου. • Κουμπιά Κλήσης και WhatsApp. 4. Διορθώσεις στο υπάρχον site • Να φύγουν οι τόνοι από τα κεφαλαία. • Αντικατάσταση των stock φωτογραφιών με δικές μου, ενιαίες γραμματοσειρές, διόρθωση μενού και footer, μικρές οπτικές διορθώσεις. 5. GDPR • Cookie banner με ισότιμα κουμπιά «Αποδοχή / Απόρριψη», σύμφωνα με τις οδηγίες της Αρχής Προστασίας Δεδομένων (ΑΠΔΠΧ), με Google Consent Mode v2. Τα εργαλεία της Google να φορτώνουν μόνο μετά τη συγκατάθεση. • Σελίδα Πολιτικής απορρήτου & cookies και σύντομο σημείωμα κάτω από τη φόρμα. 6. SEO και μετρήσεις • SEO τίτλοι και meta descriptions, sitemap, Google Search Console, συμπίεση εικόνων, 301 redirects για όσα URLs αλλάζουν. Απαιτήσεις • Αποδεδειγμένη εμπειρία σε WordPress και Elementor (με παραδείγματα από sites που είναι online). • Εμπειρία με plugins συγκατάθεσης cookies (π.χ. Complianz, CookieYes) και Google Consent Mode v2. • Βασικές γνώσεις SEO. • Το site να δείχνει τέλεια στο κινητό (mobile-first). Παραδοτέα • Όλες οι αλλαγές ανεβασμένες στο site και ελεγμένες σε κινητό και υπολογιστή. • Backup του site πριν και μετά τις αλλαγές. • Λίστα με τα redirects που έγιναν. • Σύντομες οδηγίες για να μπορώ να αλλάζω μόνος μου φωτογραφίες και κείμενα."

opportunities.description: BAHORA LUTFIYEVA Junior Interior Designer | Interior Space Planning --- PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Creative and detail-oriented Junior Interior Designer with an academic background in Interior Design. Skilled in developing interior design concepts, functional space planning, furniture layouts, and visual presentations. Experienced in working on residential and commercial interior design projects as part of academic studies. Proficient in Archicad 28 and Figma. Interested in creating functional, aesthetically pleasing, and well-organized spaces that meet clients' needs. Currently seeking freelance opportunities to develop professional experience and collaborate with international clients. Netflix Office Interior Design - Developed a conceptual interior design for a multi-level office building. - Organized functional workspaces and collaborative areas. - Focused on spatial efficiency, circulation, and ergonomics. ADDITIONAL EDUCATION Two years of art studies, developing skills in artistic composition, visual observation, and creative thinking. LANGUAGES - Uzbek — Native - English — Intermediate (B1) - Russian — [Specify your level]

opportunities.title: Pembantu Khidmat Pelanggan Sambilan
opportunities.description: Saya memerlukan seseorang yang boleh bekerja secara sambilan sebagai pembantu khidmat pelanggan. opportunities.title: Commission-Based Client Acquisition Partners
opportunities.description: I run an established consultancy and accounting firm and I’m opening up a commission programme for freelancers who can expand our client base. The assignments we want you to channel toward us cover Accounting and bookkeeping work, Business consulting work, and Tax and compliance work. The people you’ll be reaching are Small businesses and startups, Medium-sized companies, as well as Individual professionals and taxpayers. Your exact level of involvement is up to you: you may simply find leads and share their contact details, arrange meetings with interested clients, or take the relationship all the way to close and hand over the assignment. The deeper your involvement, the higher the commission tier you earn, and payouts are released on a regular monthly schedule once the engagement fee is received from the client. Deliverables I need from you for each opportunity: • Lead sheet with accurate contact info and a brief on the client’s pain points • Confirmation of any meetings you have set up (date, time, participants) • For closed deals, a copy of the signed engagement or email confirmation handing the work to our firm I provide proposal templates, service decks, and pricing guides so you can speak confidently about our offerings. All communication and status updates can be handled through email, WhatsApp, or any CRM you prefer—as long as I receive the deliverables above. If you already have a network in these segments or enjoy outreach and relationship building, this is a straightforward way to earn recurring commissions while helping companies secure reliable professional services. Let’s start onboarding you right away so you can begin pitching.

opportunities.title: AI SaaS MVP Development
opportunities.description: I’m building ELVORA Technologies, an all-in-one AI workspace aimed first at individual professionals and freelancers. The initial release must feel polished yet lean, so I need a partner who can translate the vision into a rock-solid MVP and advise on the smartest stack decisions along the way. Scope of the MVP The first cut will centre on three pillars: • an AI chat assistant that stores conversation history, • a responsive dashboard that brings several AI tools together, and • workflow automation tying everything to popular business apps. Key integrations for this iteration include OpenAI/ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Zapier, HubSpot and Notion. A future-proof approach to adding further APIs is important. What I expect from you – Work with me to refine requirements, select the optimal mix of React, Next.js, Node.js, Python or any alternative you can justify, and outline the data model and SaaS architecture. – Produce a detailed development roadmap with milestones, timeline and transparent cost breakdown. – Build the front-end dashboard, AI chat interface, secure user authentication, back-end services and database schema. – Implement the above integrations and a basic workflow engine that can trigger actions across the connected apps. – Deploy to a scalable cloud environment and hand over documentation so the platform is easy to maintain and extend. Acceptance criteria 1. Users sign up, log in and see a personalised dashboard on desktop and mobile. 2. They can chat with the assistant, which uses the chosen LLMs and keeps a searchable history. 3. From the same screen they can launch actions in the integrated apps; automation rules can be created, edited and executed successfully. 4. All services are containerised or otherwise cloud-ready with CI/CD in place. 5. Code passes agreed unit and integration tests and is covered by concise technical docs. If this sounds like the kind of build you excel at, I’d love to review your proposed stack, roadmap and approach.

opportunities.title: Lead Generation Project – 10 Free-Trial Sign-Ups ($40 USD Fixed)
opportunities.description: We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded digital promoter to drive user sign-ups for a leading international audiobook platform. The goal is simple and straightforward: generate 10 verified free-trial sign-ups within 1 month for a fixed project payment of $40 USD ($4.00 USD per valid lead). About the Offer & How Sign-Up Works: • Users get a 30-day free trial with 3 audiobooks included, open to the general public worldwide. • Important (Full Transparency): Just like any major subscription service (such as Netflix or Spotify), the user must link a valid payment method to activate the free trial, though they are charged $0 upfront and can cancel anytime before the 30 days end at no cost. • Precisely because this verification step is required to prevent fake accounts, we offer a high payout of $4.00 USD per confirmed sign-up. Workflow, Timeline & Payment Structure (100% Guaranteed): This project has a 1-month timeframe and is divided into 2 clear milestones for mutual security: • Milestone 1 – Initial Test (3 leads = $12 USD – Must be completed within 1 week): We start with an initial test of 3 valid sign-ups. These first 3 leads must be completed within your first 7 days so we can verify your traffic quality and approve you to continue for the rest of the month. They count toward your 10-lead total. • Milestone 2 – Final Stage (7 leads = $28 USD): Delivery and validation of the remaining 7 verified sign-ups over the rest of the month to complete the 10-lead goal and unlock the full $40 USD payment. • Protected Payments: Each milestone is funded upfront in Freelancer escrow before starting that stage and released within 24 hours once the target is met and verified. • Transparent Tracking: You will receive a custom affiliate link with your own unique Sub-ID so your leads are tracked accurately and separately from anyone else's. Important Role Details & Quality Rules: • No Brand Access Required: I operate as an independent affiliate partner, so this role does not involve managing, posting on, or accessing official company social media accounts or websites. • How Top Freelancers Succeed: You will promote using your own channels, social networks, student/work groups, communities, or direct word-of-mouth with friends, family, and acquaintances. Simple, direct recommendations work fastest! • Results-Based Payment: Please note this is a milestone-based project paid upon verified sign-ups, not an hourly or fixed-salary role regardless of results. • Strict Quality Rule: All traffic must be 100% organic and genuine. Every user must sign up from their own internet connection or mobile data (sharing the same Wi-Fi network or IP address, VPNs, bots, giveaways, or incentivized traffic are strictly prohibited). Delivery & Validation Requirements: To validate each milestone and release the corresponding payment: 1. The sign-ups must show as approved in my affiliate dashboard under your unique Sub-ID link. 2. You must submit a brief Microsoft Word document stating the total number of leads generated in that stage and the methods used (word-of-mouth, social media, groups, etc.) to cross-check with the dashboard data. Performance Perks & Higher Volume Capacity: If you can reach more people and generate more than 10 leads per month, please state your monthly capacity directly in your proposal along with your adjusted bid amount (at $4.00 USD per valid lead). For example, if you can deliver 25 leads in a month, submit a bid for $100 USD and specify that target in your message. To Apply, Please Answer Briefly: 1. Which methods or channels will you use to get the sign-ups (word-of-mouth, personal network, groups, social media, etc.)? 2. Can you commit to completing the Milestone 1 test (first 3 valid leads) within 1 week (7 days), and the full 10 leads within 1 month? 3. Monthly Capacity & Bid: If you can generate more than 10 leads per month, how many can you commit to, and what is your total bid amount for the project based on that volume? We hire quickly and are looking for action-oriented people ready to start today! IMPORTANT NOTE – Fast-Delivery Bonus & Long-Term Perks: If you complete all 10 valid leads within 2 weeks (14 days) instead of the full month, you will receive an extra bonus commission on top of your $40 USD payout for delivering ahead of schedule! Additionally, based on your speed and traffic quality, we can establish guaranteed fixed monthly payments and higher commission rates for the following months.

opportunities.description: We are looking for an experienced B2B Lead Generation and Appointment Setting Specialist who can build a consistent pipeline of qualified prospects for Craybizz, a custom software development and digital solutions agency. Our goal is to connect with businesses that have genuine technology requirements and are looking for a reliable development partner. We are interested in a long-term collaboration with someone who can generate meaningful business opportunities rather than simply provide contact databases. Target Markets - United States - United Kingdom - Canada - Australia - United Arab Emirates - India Ideal Customer Profile Small and medium-sized businesses, startups, and established companies across the following industries: - Real Estate and Property Development - Healthcare and Medical Services - Finance and Professional Services - Retail and E-commerce - Logistics and Manufacturing - IT Consulting and Digital Marketing Agencies - SaaS and Technology Companies Services We Offer - Custom Software Development - Website Design, Development and Modernization - Web and Mobile Application Development - Custom CRM and Business Management Systems - Real Estate Technology Solutions - SaaS Product and MVP Development - Business Process Automation and API Integrations - Website Performance Optimization - White-Label Development Partnerships - Ongoing Technical Support and Maintenance Scope of Work - Research and build highly targeted prospect lists. - Identify business owners, founders, CEOs, CTOs and relevant decision-makers. - Identify companies with genuine software development, website modernization or automation requirements. - Create and execute personalized multi-touch outreach campaigns using email, LinkedIn and other relevant channels. - Nurture prospects through consistent follow-ups. - Qualify prospects based on their requirements, budget, timeline and decision-making authority. - Schedule qualified discovery calls directly on our calendar. - Maintain accurate prospect information and communication history in our CRM. - Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on campaign performance. Success Metrics - Target of 10–15 qualified discovery appointments per month, with realistic targets agreed upon before starting. - Verified and relevant business prospects. - Clear qualification notes for every scheduled meeting. - Genuine interest in our software development services. - Weekly performance reports covering outreach volume, response rates, positive replies, booked meetings and attended meetings. We do not consider purchased contact lists, duplicate leads, irrelevant prospects or uninterested contacts to be qualified leads. Required Experience - Proven experience in B2B lead generation and appointment setting. - Previous experience working with software development agencies or IT service companies. - Strong understanding of international B2B sales. - Excellent English communication and copywriting skills. - Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, HubSpot or similar tools. - Experience developing personalized outreach campaigns. - Ability to demonstrate measurable results from previous engagements. Compensation & Engagement We are open to a performance-oriented compensation model, including: - Fixed monthly compensation. - Performance-based incentives. - Additional commission on successfully closed projects. We will begin with a 30-day paid trial, with the opportunity for a long-term engagement based on performance. When Applying Please include: 1. Your experience generating clients for software development agencies. 2. Previous campaign results or relevant case studies. 3. Your proposed strategy for acquiring clients in international markets. 4. The tools and platforms you use. 5. The number of qualified appointments you can realistically generate per month. 6. Your proposed monthly pricing and compensation structure. 7. Any additional costs associated with tools or outreach infrastructure. Please start your proposal with **CRAYBIZZ GROWTH**. We are looking for a proactive, experienced and reliable growth partner who can help us build a sustainable client acquisition pipeline.

opportunities.description: Monthly Deliverables: A minimum of 30 original, high-quality content pieces per month, excluding Stories and trending content. Creative promotional videos and Reels. Premium product and lifestyle visuals. UGC-style advertising videos. Educational and ingredient-focused content. AI-powered creative videos and 3D product animations. Additional Stories and real-time trending content. Platform-specific adaptations in 9:16, 4:5, and 1:1 formats. Full Creative Responsibilities: Market and competitor research. Monthly content strategy and planning. Creative concepts, hooks, scripts, and storyboards. Complete content production and editing. Captions, headlines, and calls to action. We need a proactive creative partner who independently researches, develops ideas, and delivers exceptional content. AI-powered production, real product visuals, and hybrid production approaches are all welcome. Our primary objective is to build a premium international brand and generate sales through compelling, conversion-focused content. Important: The 30 monthly content pieces must be original concepts, not different sizes or variations of the same creative. Stories, trending content, and format adaptations are additional deliverables. This is a long-term monthly collaboration. Please provide your portfolio, relevant product advertising examples, proposed production workflow, monthly delivery schedule, and fixed monthly price.

opportunities.title: Modern Responsive Website Build
opportunities.description: I’m looking for a developer who can take my brief and turn it into a clean, contemporary website that looks great and performs flawlessly on desktop, tablet, and mobile. The core structure is straightforward—Home, About Us, Services, and Contact—and I want each page to feel cohesive, fast, and easy to navigate. Visual appeal is key, so the UI needs to feel modern while remaining professional. I expect lightweight code, optimised images, and smart caching so pages load quickly even on slower connections. Please weave in the on-page SEO fundamentals—semantic headings, meta tags, alt text, and a tidy URL structure—so I can start ranking without extra work later. The Contact page must host an enquiry form that feeds submissions directly to my email. I also need a click-to-chat WhatsApp button so visitors can reach me instantly if they prefer. Beyond that, I’d like basic analytics set up so I can track visits and form conversions from day one. Deliverables I’ll review and sign off: • High-fidelity mock-ups for all four pages • Fully responsive build (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript or your preferred framework) • Integrated contact form with server-side handling and spam protection • WhatsApp click-to-chat integration • SEO-ready code and performance tuning (≤ 2 s load time on GTmetrix) • Deployment to my hosting plus a short hand-over walkthrough If this scope fits your skill set and you can deliver a polished result without bloat, I’m ready to get started right away. Please share a couple of recent, similar sites and your estimated timeframe.

opportunities.title: Dynamic TikTok Science Video Edits
opportunities.description: Produzco contenido científico para TikTok y Reels y necesito un editor que lo transforme en piezas cortas, ágiles y memorables. Yo te facilito todo el material en video o imágenes; tu misión será armar un formato vertical de 60-120 s, incorporar textos claros, efectos llamativos y música libre de derechos que mantenga el ritmo y la atención sin sacrificar el rigor científico. El estilo debe sentirse dinámico, con transiciones limpias, subtítulos legibles y motion graphics que destaquen datos clave. Busco creatividad para sincronizar cortes con la pista musical, aprovechar zooms, máscaras y pequeñas animaciones que refuercen conceptos. El primer video lo necesito listo cuanto antes, idealmente en las próximas semanas y seguiríamos con más de forma continua si el resultado encaja. Al finalizar cada pieza quiero el .mp4 final en 1080 × 1920 más el proyecto editable (Premiere, DaVinci o similar) para ajustes futuros. Si dominás estos recursos y tenés ejemplos similares, compartilos y avanzamos de inmediato.

opportunities.title: LinkedIn Outreach For Consulting Leads
opportunities.description: I’m ready to turn my LinkedIn presence (linkedin.com/in/nicholas-gayed) into a steady pipeline of business-consulting opportunities and I need a specialist who can make the right introductions for me. The core objective is straightforward: find potential clients who could benefit from strategic or business-consulting support, connect with them on LinkedIn, and open a genuine conversation that can lead to discovery calls. I’m not looking for a one-size-fits-all blast; each outreach should feel personal, relevant, and aligned with the prospect’s needs. Here’s how I picture the collaboration: • Analyse my existing profile so every touchpoint—from headline to About section—supports our outreach narrative. • Define the ideal decision-maker persona and build targeted search filters. • Craft concise, value-driven connection and follow-up messages that sound like me. • Execute daily connection requests, track acceptance and response rates, and adjust the copy or targeting when something isn’t landing. • Provide a simple weekly report: who was contacted, who replied, what next steps we have. I’m happy to supply background materials, past case studies, or any additional context you need. If you have a proven record of booking calls through LinkedIn using Sales Navigator, automation tools, or purely manual outreach, I’d love to hear how you’ll apply that experience here. Let’s start with a short pilot: one week of outreach, 80–100 tailored connection attempts, and clear metrics on acceptance and reply rates. If the numbers look good, we’ll roll into a longer engagement together. @quartermaster Please see this!!!!

opportunities.title: Исполнительная документация промышленного объекта （Long‑term ）
opportunities.description: Тре́буется носи́тель языка́, рабо́та на ме́сте. Место работы — Владивосток. Нужно упорядочить и довести до идеального состояния систему исполнительной документации по промышленному/складскому объекту, чтобы она без вопросов прошла проверку государственных органов и приёмку заказчика. Сейчас на руках только часть бумаг: отдельные акты, журналы и сертификаты. Остальное предстоит восстановить, сверить с проектной документацией и привести к единому формату в соответствии с актуальными российскими нормами ведения исполнительной документации. Что ожидаю получить • Акты освидетельствования скрытых работ и исполнительные схемы в согласованной форме (DWG/PDF). • Журналы работ, паспорта и сертификаты материалов, собранные и откорректированные. • Полный комплект документации для сдачи объекта, прошитый, пронумерованный и подготовленный к архивированию (электронный и, при необходимости, бумажный вариант). Ключевые задачи – Проверить имеющиеся документы, выявить пробелы. – Запросить у подрядчиков недостающие сведения либо сформировать их по фактическим данным. – Согласовать акты и схемы с надзорными лицами. – Структурировать файлы, присвоить индекс, сформировать итоговый реестр. – Подготовить архивный пакет: прошивка/сканирование, финальный PDF-портфель. Жду специалиста, знакомого с СП 48.13330, ГОСТ 21 и другими профильными требованиями, уверенно работающего в AutoCAD, Excel и ПО для PDF-компоновки.

opportunities.title: Tailings & Slurry System Engineer
opportunities.description: I am planning a full engineering study for a tailings / slurry handling project and need everything documented to a standard that satisfies both internal management and external regulators. The assignment starts with gathering the operating data I will provide— flow rates, solids content, elevation profile— then moves through hydraulic and geotechnical calculations, pipeline and pump sizing, and culminates in a clear engineering package. The final package must include: • a concise design brief that explains the governing assumptions and equations • annotated drawings in AutoCAD (or compatible) showing pipe routes, pump stations, and deposition areas • an Excel or similar calculation file so the numbers remain transparent and easy to audit • a short risk and operability commentary highlighting wear, blockage, and containment issues If you already use tools such as FLAC, ANSYS, or Pipeline Studio, feel free to leverage them—just provide native files with a PDF summary so I can review without extra licenses. Draft deliverables are expected two weeks after kick-off; I will review and return comments within three days. A single revised submission should then close the project.

opportunities.title: Android App Testing Community Coordinators
opportunities.description: Android App Testers Wanted – Ring by Daysli We are looking for reliable Android users to test 'Ring by Daysli', a new lightweight communication application designed to make everyday conversations simpler, faster and more convenient. Our web application, https://ring.daysli.com, is already operational and tested. We are now focusing on testing our native Android application on real smartphones before its wider public release. Project responsibilities Each selected freelancer will be required to: - Install the Ring Android application through our Google Play testing programme. - Create a dedicated testing account following our registration instructions. - Actively use and test the application. - Recruit five additional genuine Android testers. - Help those five testers register and install the application. - Encourage each of those five testers to bring another five Android testers. - Coordinate testing activities and collect feedback from their testing community. Each freelancer should aim to establish a testing group of 31 participants, including themselves. All participants must be genuine Android users who voluntarily agree to participate and actively test the application. Testing requirements We want testers to evaluate the following: - Application installation and registration. - Google sign-in and account setup. - Incoming and outgoing voice calls. - Sending and receiving messages. - Finding contacts by username. - Incoming call and message notifications. - Receiving calls when the application is closed or the phone is locked. - Our “Ring when we're both free” feature. - Missed, declined and cancelled calls. - Communication between Android and web users. - Application speed and responsiveness. - Battery and mobile data consumption. - Performance on Wi-Fi and mobile networks. - Network interruptions and reconnection. - Overall design, usability and reliability. Testing accounts All participants must register dedicated testing accounts using the instructions we provide. Selected freelancers will receive: - Google Play testing access instructions. - Test account registration instructions. - Tester invitation instructions. - Testing guidelines. - Bug reporting and feedback submission instructions. Participants must follow these instructions so that testing activity can be distinguished from genuine customer activity. Feedback and deliverables Each freelancer must submit a consolidated report containing: - Number of registered and active testers. - Android phone models and operating system versions tested. - Features successfully tested. - Bugs and technical problems discovered. - Screenshots or screen recordings of issues. - Genuine feedback from participating testers. - Suggestions for improving the application. - Comparison with existing communication applications such as WhatsApp, Viber, Telegram and Signal. - Whether testers would consider using Ring for everyday communication. Applicant requirements - Own an Android smartphone. - Have access to a Google Play account. - Be able to recruit and coordinate additional Android testers. - Have good communication skills. - Be willing to actively test the application and provide constructive feedback. - Be available for continued testing during the agreed testing period. Previous application testing experience is welcome but not mandatory. We welcome applicants from all countries and are particularly interested in testing across different Android versions, smartphone brands, network providers and geographical locations. When applying, please include - Your country. - Your Android smartphone brand and model. - Your Android version. - Your ability to recruit and coordinate additional Android testers. - Your availability. - Your previous testing experience, if any. - Your proposed total project fee. Payment will be based on genuine testing, coordination and completed feedback deliverables, not registrations alone. Successful freelancers may be considered for ongoing paid testing opportunities for future Ring releases. Website: https://ring.daysli.com Help us build a faster, lighter and more reliable communication application for everyone.

Project responsibilities Each selected freelancer will be required to: - Install the Ring Android application through our Google Play testing programme. - Create a dedicated testing account following our registration instructions. - Actively use and test the application. - Recruit five additional genuine Android testers. - Help those five testers register and install the application. - Encourage each of those five testers to bring another five Android testers. - Coordinate testing activities and collect feedback from their testing community. Each freelancer should aim to establish a testing group of 31 participants, including themselves. All participants must be genuine Android users who voluntarily agree to participate and actively test the application. Testing requirements We want testers to evaluate the following: - Application installation and registration. - Google sign-in and account setup. - Incoming and outgoing voice calls. - Sending and receiving messages. - Finding contacts by username. - Incoming call and message notifications. - Receiving calls when the application is closed or the phone is locked. - Our “Ring when we're both free” feature. - Missed, declined and cancelled calls. - Communication between Android and web users. - Application speed and responsiveness. - Battery and mobile data consumption. - Performance on Wi-Fi and mobile networks. - Network interruptions and reconnection. - Overall design, usability and reliability. Testing accounts All participants must register dedicated testing accounts using the instructions we provide. Selected freelancers will receive: - Google Play testing access instructions. - Test account registration instructions. - Tester invitation instructions. - Testing guidelines. - Bug reporting and feedback submission instructions. Participants must follow these instructions so that testing activity can be distinguished from genuine customer activity. Feedback and deliverables Each freelancer must submit a consolidated report containing: - Number of registered and active testers. - Android phone models and operating system versions tested. - Features successfully tested. - Bugs and technical problems discovered. - Screenshots or screen recordings of issues. - Genuine feedback from participating testers. - Suggestions for improving the application. - Comparison with existing communication applications such as WhatsApp, Viber, Telegram and Signal. - Whether testers would consider using Ring for everyday communication. Applicant requirements - Own an Android smartphone. - Have access to a Google Play account. - Be able to recruit and coordinate additional Android testers. - Have good communication skills. - Be willing to actively test the application and provide constructive feedback. - Be available for continued testing during the agreed testing period. Previous application testing experience is welcome but not mandatory. We welcome applicants from all countries and are particularly interested in testing across different Android versions, smartphone brands, network providers and geographical locations. When applying, please include - Your country. - Your Android smartphone brand and model. - Your Android version. - Your ability to recruit and coordinate additional Android testers. - Your availability. - Your previous testing experience, if any. - Your proposed total project fee. Payment will be based on genuine testing, coordination and completed feedback deliverables, not registrations alone. Successful freelancers may be considered for ongoing paid testing opportunities for future Ring releases. Website: https://ring.daysli.com Help us build a faster, lighter and more reliable communication application for everyone."

opportunities.title: Grow My WhatsApp Humor Channel
opportunities.description: I run a WhatsApp channel centred on news, entertainment, and lifestyle, but the heartbeat of the feed is quick, funny, and share-worthy posts. I want to expand the follower base far beyond my current circle and reach a broad audience that simply enjoys light-hearted, entertaining content. Your task is to plan and execute a promotional campaign that puts the channel in front of the right eyes and converts that visibility into real subscribers. I’m open to any mix of organic tactics—cross-platform social promotion, meme marketing, short-form video teasers—as well as paid boosts if you can show they’ll deliver measurable results. Creative growth hacks, influencer shout-outs, or community partnerships are all on the table as long as they align with WhatsApp’s policies. What I’ll look for: • A concise strategy outlining channels, timelines, and expected subscriber growth. • All creative assets you develop (copy, visuals, or video snippets) delivered in reusable formats. • Weekly progress reports so I can see how each tactic is performing in real numbers. If you have past success growing WhatsApp or similar social channels, share a quick example so I can gauge fit. I’m ready to get started as soon as we agree on a clear roadmap and milestones.

opportunities.title: Educational Kids Animation Ages 5–7
opportunities.description: I’m producing a bright, engaging educational animation for children aged 5-7 that will introduce and reinforce letters, numbers, and other early-school basics. I have the core learning objectives mapped out; what I need now is a creative partner who can bring them to life with lively characters, clear storytelling, and age-appropriate humor. Here’s what I’m looking for you to handle from start to finish: • Script and storyboard grounded in proven early-literacy and numeracy techniques • Full animation production (2D or 3D—whichever you do best) with smooth, colorful visuals that keep young viewers’ attention • Kid-friendly voice-over and sound design that complement the on-screen action • Final deliverable in 1080p MP4 plus editable project files so updates are easy down the road Acceptance criteria: the finished video should run between three and five minutes, present each concept only once per scene to avoid overload, and pass a quick test screening with a small focus group of 5-to-7-year-olds (I’ll arrange that) who can summarize at least three new things they learned after watching. If you specialize in educational content and enjoy crafting fun, memorable experiences for early learners, I’d love to see your reel and talk timing.

opportunities.title: 3D Printable Decorative Gift Model
opportunities.description: I’d like a skilled 3D artist to transform my concept for a small decorative gift into a model that I can send straight to the printer. The piece will be printed on an FDM machine, so please keep wall thickness, overhangs, and support requirements in mind while you sculpt. I’ll provide a simple sketch, dimensions (about 120 mm tall), and a few reference photos once we begin. Clean surface detail is important—I want it to look good after light sanding—yet the mesh should remain efficient enough to slice quickly in Cura at 0.12 mm. Deliverables • Watertight, print-ready STL • Editable source file (Blender, Fusion 360, or similar) • Two basic clay-style renders for approval After the first print, I’ll share photos and measurements; one revision round may be needed to fine-tune tolerances or support placement. If you’ve created decorative or gift-style models for 3D printing before, please show a couple of examples so I can gauge style and printability.

opportunities.title: CRM Reports Dashboard Error Fix
opportunities.description: I’m running into a blocking issue inside my CRM: whenever I open the reports and dashboard area, the page either throws an error or refuses to load altogether. All other sections work fine, so the problem looks isolated to the data-reporting module. Here’s what I need from you: • Diagnose the root cause of the loading/error problem in the reports-dashboard component. • Repair or replace the offending code, query, or configuration so the section loads quickly and displays the correct data. • Confirm that existing reports render accurately once the fix is applied and that no other CRM functions are affected. • Provide a brief summary of the changes so I can track what was done and re-apply if I migrate servers in the future. Acceptance criteria: the reports page must open without errors, dashboards must populate with live data, and your fix should pass at least one day of normal usage without regression. I can give you immediate access to the server and log files as soon as we agree to proceed.

opportunities.title: Modern Garden Water-Feature Design
opportunities.description: I have an outdoor area that I want transformed into a striking, contemporary landscape. The space should immediately impress guests yet feel cohesive and low-maintenance once installed. A signature water element—a sleek fountain or still pond—must sit at the heart of the design and set the tone for the rest of the garden. Here’s how I picture the collaboration working: • Concept development: mood boards or rough sketches that capture the overall geometry, planting palette, lighting ideas, and the central water feature. • Detailed plan set: scaled drawings (SketchUp, AutoCAD, or similar) showing hard-scaping, plant placement, lighting points, and full construction details for the fountain/pond, including pumps and filtration. • Visuals: at least two high-resolution renderings or a short walkthrough animation to help me visualise the space before build. • Materials & plant list: quantities, sizes, and recommended suppliers where possible so I can source locally. I’ll provide current site photos and measurements as soon as we start. Two rounds of revisions are included so the final package feels just right. When everything is approved, deliver the files in PDF plus editable formats. If you love minimalist lines, understand modern outdoor lighting, and can make a water feature the undeniable focal point, I’m ready to get started right away.

opportunities.title: Automatización IA Respuestas Multicanal CRM
opportunities.description: Quiero construir un sistema que, a partir de nuestros historiales de conversación con clientes, sugiera respuestas inteligentes para los mensajes que ingresan tanto por correo electrónico como por WhatsApp. Flujo deseado • Cuando llega un mensaje, la IA genera una respuesta preliminar usando los chats previos como base de conocimiento. • Esa respuesta se muestra en una página web donde mi equipo puede leerla, editarla si hace falta y aprobarla antes de enviarla. • En horario laboral, la respuesta aprobada se envía automáticamente; fuera de horario no debe responder nada. Integración con WhatsApp • Cada correo entrante debe reenviarse también a nuestro número de WhatsApp para que, si lo preferimos, podamos contestar con un mensaje de voz. • El sistema debe transcribir ese audio y devolverlo al hilo de correo como texto formateado. Seguimiento de oportunidades Si un cliente no responde o la venta no se cierra, la plataforma enviará recordatorios automáticos que incluyen un descuento configurable para incentivar la compra. Requisitos técnicos clave – Canales obligatorios: correo electrónico y WhatsApp. – Motor de IA entrenado en nuestros chats históricos. – Panel web simple y rápido para aprobar cada mensaje. – Restricción de horario configurable. – Registro estilo CRM: conversación, estado, fecha del último recordatorio y resultado. Entregables mínimos 1. Código fuente completo y documentación de instalación. 2. Panel web funcional para vista previa y aprobación. 3. Conectores operativos a Gmail/IMAP y API de WhatsApp Business. 4. Lógica de follow-up con descuentos y control de horario. 5. Guía rápida para que mi equipo pueda ajustar prompts, descuentos y horarios sin depender de desarrollo.

opportunities.verbatim_request: "Quiero construir un sistema que, a partir de nuestros historiales de conversación con clientes, sugiera respuestas inteligentes para los mensajes que ingresan tanto por correo electrónico como por WhatsApp. Flujo deseado • Cuando llega un mensaje, la IA genera una respuesta preliminar usando los chats previos como base de conocimiento. • Esa respuesta se muestra en una página web donde mi equipo puede leerla, editarla si hace falta y aprobarla antes de enviarla. • En horario laboral, la respuesta aprobada se envía automáticamente; fuera de horario no debe responder nada. Integración con WhatsApp • Cada correo entrante debe reenviarse también a nuestro número de WhatsApp para que, si lo preferimos, podamos contestar con un mensaje de voz. • El sistema debe transcribir ese audio y devolverlo al hilo de correo como texto formateado. Seguimiento de oportunidades Si un cliente no responde o la venta no se cierra, la plataforma enviará recordatorios automáticos que incluyen un descuento configurable para incentivar la compra. Requisitos técnicos clave – Canales obligatorios: correo electrónico y WhatsApp. – Motor de IA entrenado en nuestros chats históricos. – Panel web simple y rápido para aprobar cada mensaje. – Restricción de horario configurable. – Registro estilo CRM: conversación, estado, fecha del último recordatorio y resultado. Entregables mínimos 1. Código fuente completo y documentación de instalación. 2. Panel web funcional para vista previa y aprobación. 3. Conectores operativos a Gmail/IMAP y API de WhatsApp Business. 4. Lógica de follow-up con descuentos y control de horario. 5. Guía rápida para que mi equipo pueda ajustar prompts, descuentos y horarios sin depender de desarrollo."

Si tienes experiencia demostrable lanzando campañas de respuesta directa y puedes cumplir este reto exprés, espero tu propuesta.

proposal.body:
¡Hola Cliente J. V.! 👋 Un cordial saludo desde San Agustín, Huila.

Somos un emprendimiento productor y comercializador de **Café Especial de Origen San Agustín / Sur del Huila** con perfilación sensorial avalada por **Catador Q-Grader (+85 a 89 puntos SCA)** y nos comunicamos respecto a **Creación de Video Inmobiliario Profesional con Intro Cómica y Diseñ...**:

☕ **1. Café Borbón Rosado Tostado y Molido a Medida**: Entregamos en grano entero o con el **nivel exacto de molienda** (fina espresso, media V60/Chemex/filtro, gruesa prensa francesa) y **curva de tostión** (clara, media o media-oscura) que requiera su empresa o cliente (presentaciones de 250g, 500g y bolsas institucionales por kilos con válvula desgasificadora).
📦 **2. Lotes Más Grandes y Microlotes**: Disponibilidad de lotes mayores en pergamino seco seleccionado (humedad 10%-11.5%), café verde tipo exportación o tostado por volumen con trazabilidad directa de vereda en San Agustín (Alto del Obispo, La Estrella, El Tablón, Los Cauchos).
🏅 **3. Calidad Garantizada**: Perfil dulce, limpio, notas a panela, melocotón y flor de café, libre de defectos primarios.

📲 Nuestro WhatsApp directo es **+57 322 273 9034**. ¿A qué dirección o laboratorio les enviamos muestra física y ficha técnica de nuestro Borbón Rosado?

opportunities.title: Site Layout CAD Drafting
opportunities.description: I need a clean, professional set of site layout and land-development drawings created from my hand-drawn sketch. The sketch already shows building footprints, key measurements, and the general parking arrangement; I now need it translated into a properly scaled CAD file that clearly identifies property lines, each building, and all parking spaces. You will be working from the sketch and any follow-up clarifications I provide, so experience interpreting field measurements and rough diagrams is essential. Please prepare the drawing in AutoCAD (Civil 3D or standard DWG format) so it can slot straight into our consultant workflow. Deliverables: • One fully layered CAD file (.dwg) that includes property boundaries, building outlines, and the complete parking layout • A plotted PDF set at 1”=20’ (or similar) for quick review • A short revision round to address red-line comments if anything needs tweaking Accuracy, tidy layer management, and adherence to the provided dimensions are the key acceptance criteria. Let me know your timeline and any comparable samples you can share, and we can get started right away.

opportunities.title: Open-Source AI Funnel Automation
opportunities.description: I’m ready to wire up a fully-automated, open-source growth engine and need an architect who can turn my scattered ideas into a single, self-managing system. The focus is on creating bots and autonomous agents, then chaining them into a smooth workflow that captures, qualifies, and nurtures every contact. Scope • Channels in play: WhatsApp, Email, Website chat, Instagram DM, and RCS. Each must be covered end-to-end—from the first “Hi” to either a booked call or a resolved support ticket. • Core tasks: design the conversation flows, spin up the bots, connect them to an LLM or other NLP layer, store context in a vector database, and sync everything back to my CRM/marketing automation tool. • Automation logic: trigger-based hand-offs between channels, intelligent follow-ups, and clear escalation paths to a human when confidence scores drop. • Stack preference: open-source components wherever possible so I stay free of vendor lock-in. Deliverables 1. A documented architecture diagram (PDF + editable source) showing all services, data flows, and fail-safes. 2. Working bot/agent instances live on each channel, tested with real messages. 3. Workflow rules and code (Python, NodeJS, or similar) pushed to my GitHub repo, ready for CI/CD. 4. Quick-start guide so I can tweak intents, training data, and follow-up cadences without coming back to you for minor edits. Acceptance criteria • A single inbound message on any listed channel is routed, answered, and logged in the CRM within five seconds. • Lead qualification data (name, email, intent, score) is visible in the CRM dashboard. • A test lead receives at least three automated follow-ups across two channels without duplication or delay. If you thrive on stitching together open-source tools, automating funnels, and making multi-channel bots feel human, let’s talk.

opportunities.title: Complete Home Interior Design Plan
opportunities.description: I’m ready to give my apartment a fresh start and I’d like an experienced interior designer to take the lead on the entire place—not just one room. I need a fully-fleshed design package that covers layout, style direction, colour palette, materials, and décor for several rooms so everything ties together beautifully. Here’s what I’m looking for: • Scaled floor plans and elevations that show clear furniture placement for each room • Mood boards or 3D visuals to communicate the overall concept and finishes • A detailed shopping list with product links, quantities, and estimated costs so I can order items easily • Guidance on paint colours, lighting, fabrics, and accessories that suit the design vision • Drawings or renderings accurate enough for contractors to follow if any minor build-outs are required I already have basic measurements and photos, and I’m available to provide more information or hop on a quick call to discuss style preferences and practical needs. Please include samples of past whole-home or multi-room projects—especially any before-and-after visuals—so I can see how you translate ideas into reality. The goal is to finish with a coordinated, actionable plan that lets me purchase, install, and enjoy the new look without second-guessing decisions along the way. If this sounds like a fit, I’d love to hear how you would approach the project and an estimated timeline for the design deliverables.

opportunities.title: 3D Slot UI Animations
opportunities.description: I’m developing a vibrant, fantasy-flavoured casino slot and need a skilled 3D artist–animator to bring the whole interface to life. The overall look should feel like a bright casino floor seasoned with magical, other-worldly touches. Scope • Characters & Backgrounds – Model, rig and animate one or two hero characters plus looping scenic backdrops that feel alive yet never distract from the reels. • Slot Symbols & Win Effects – Create high-poly, textured symbols (gems, chests, wilds, scatters, etc.) and their accompanying burst, sparkle or coin-shower animations to celebrate wins. • UI Motion – Animate buttons, menus, screen transitions and any subtle hover or press feedback so the experience remains cohesive from lobby to bonus round. Technical Notes – 3D packages such as Maya, Blender or 3ds Max are fine; please export to FBX (PBR-ready) and provide layered source files. – Final game will render in Unity, so keep polycounts and texture sizes optimised for mobile. – Loop points must be clean; effects should composite easily onto transparent backgrounds (PNG sequences or 32-bit MOV). – I’m open on specific fantasy motifs—feel free to pitch concepts that fit the “bright casino with fantasy elements” direction. Deliverables 1. Rigged character FBX + idle, celebrate and react loops 2. Layered 3D background scene with seamless loop camera pass 3. Full symbol set (static + animated versions) 4. Win effect VFX clips (transparent) 5. UI assets: buttons in all states, animated transitions 6. Source files and a short demo video showing everything in motion I’ll review each milestone in-engine to confirm colour balance, loop smoothness and overall polish. If you thrive on colourful 3D work and fluid game-ready animation, let’s talk and set up the first concept sprint.

opportunities.title: Diseño de Línea Gráfica y Landing Page para Aplicación Web Innovadora
opportunities.description: Se busca un diseñador gráfico altamente creativo, ingenioso y proactivo para desarrollar la línea gráfica completa de una aplicación web. El proyecto incluye la presentación de varias opciones de diseño visual, basadas en capturas de pantalla del login y diversas pantallas del sistema. Una vez seleccionada la línea gráfica, el profesional deberá crear una lista estandarizada de diseño para cada elemento de la aplicación, incluyendo paletas de colores, tipografías, iconos, aspectos de interactividad (como colores en movimientos y estados de selección), y otros detalles visuales. Adicionalmente, se requiere el diseño de una landing page que refleje un aspecto serio, profesional y novedoso, alineado con la identidad visual de la aplicación. opportunities.title: Gestión Ads Facebook Instagram TikTok Ventas
opportunities.description: Vendo principalmente muebles de dormitorio a través de mi tienda online y quiero que las campañas de Facebook, Instagram y TikTok se conviertan en un flujo constante de nuevos clientes y ventas. El objetivo es muy claro: aumentar conversiones en la web, no solo visitas. Necesito que planifiques, ejecutes y optimices campañas orientadas a compras, configures correctamente el píxel y los eventos de conversión, segmentes audiencias frías y de remarketing, y mantengas los anuncios afinados para obtener el mejor retorno posible. El enfoque será performance-marketing: pruebas A/B, ajuste de presupuestos, creatividad persuasiva y análisis de datos en tiempo real. Entrego acceso a mi Business Manager, TikTok Ads y la web; tú aportas la estrategia, y el seguimiento semanal de métricas clave (CTR, CPA, ROAS). los copies, el diseño de piezas estáticas o videos cortos los trabajarìamos de la mano de un diseñador grafico. Deliverables esperados - Presupuesto adecuado mensual. • Estrategia y estructura de campañas en tres plataformas • Configuración de píxeles y eventos de compra verificados • Informe semanal con optimizaciones realizadas y próximos pasos El proyecto se considerará aceptado cuando los anuncios estén activos, midan conversiones correctamente y el coste por compra se mantenga dentro del rango acordado en nuestro primer briefing. Si dominas Meta Ads, TikTok Ads Manager, análisis de audiencias y copy orientado a e-commerce, adelanta tu propuesta y cronograma de lanzamiento.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40833875, publicado hace 19 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: EUR 250 - 750.

Puedo aportar acceso al Apple ID vinculado y cualquier dato adicional que necesites para verificar mi propiedad (facturas, número de serie, IMEI). Lo que busco es una solución efectiva y segura que deje el teléfono plenamente operativo sin perder datos ni comprometer la garantía oficial. Qué necesito de tu parte • Diagnóstico claro de por qué la contraseña no es aceptada. • Procedimiento paso a paso —o ejecución directa si es posible— para eliminar el bloqueo de activación. • Sugerencias de prevención para que el problema no se repita. Al postular, comparte ejemplos de trabajos anteriores donde hayas resuelto bloqueos de activación u otros problemas de seguridad con iOS; eso será clave para elegirte. Si dominas herramientas de soporte de Apple, configuraciones de iCloud, REST API de gestión de dispositivos o software de reparación autorizado, menciónalo: es un plus. Quiero una comunicación ágil y, sobre todo, absoluta confidencialidad con mis credenciales. Espero tu propuesta y tu experiencia para recuperar mi iPhone cuanto antes.

opportunities.title: Video Vertical Instagram SIPE
opportunities.description: Quiero un video vertical (1080 × 1920) de entre 30 y 45 segundos para pautar en Instagram Ads. Yo apareceré frente a cámara dando el mensaje; sólo necesito que edites y animes todo lo que acompaña. Concepto central Un edificio puede quedarse sin agua por fallas eléctricas o mecánicas, pero con SIPE eso se evita porque el sistema avisa de inmediato si: • salta la térmica • se desconecta el contactor • la cisterna se rebalsa • el tanque se vacía • los automáticos se traban Objetivo Transmitir a los administradores de edificios, de manera clara y cercana, que la alerta temprana de SIPE llega a quien corresponde para resolver la falla antes de quedarnos sin agua, mostrando además el monitoreo en tiempo real del volumen de la cisterna y el tanque. Estilo visual solicitado • Animaciones simples de tablero eléctrico, cisterna y tanque que aparezcan junto a mi presentación en pantalla. • Colores y tipografías coherentes con la marca. Requisitos técnicos • Formato vertical 1080 × 1920. • Subtítulos grandes y legibles (sin botones interactivos). • Música de fondo suave, sin infringir derechos. • Logo SIPE animado o estático al cierre. • Archivo final optimizado y listo para cargar directamente en Instagram Ads. Entregables 1. Video final en .mp4 (H.264) y versión editable. 2. Miniatura sugerida para la campaña. 3. Fuente de la música y tipografía empleada. Espero tu propuesta de cronograma, método de trabajo y ejemplos similares que hayas realizado.
